title: How maps behave
statement: For a Go map of type map[string]int, which statements are true? Pick every one that applies.
choices: Ranging over the map visits the keys in the order they were inserted
Reading a key that is not in the map returns 0 and does not panic
Calling delete with a key that is not in the map panics
Assigning to a key of a nil map (declared with var m map[string]int and never initialised) panics
